alphabet_recognition.instruction: Say the name of the prompted English letter once. Capture the whole utterance, then confirm the label.

isolated_word.instruction: Say only the prompted word once. Start before lip movement and finish after the complete word. HELP, I and AM are collection targets, not active model classes.

negative.instruction: Capture silence or an isolated word outside the active vocabulary. For an unknown word, record what was actually spoken. Negatives never become known-word training labels.

training_rule: Every configured class must have genuine confirmed examples in train, validation and test with disjoint speakers. This is a structural eligibility check, not evidence that the sample count or speaker diversity is sufficient.
collection_recommendation: Prioritize new speakers and missing class/split combinations. Collect a small balanced pilot, then use training-only learning curves and validation results to decide how many additional recordings are needed. No universal per-class quota is asserted.
final_test_rule: Prefer new test speakers collected after model and policy selection. Do not fit weights or select thresholds using test recordings.
